description:
Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes.

Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL. Work runs for exactly two reasons: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening: 'if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period.'

FAMILIES 1-6 — DONE (e561842ce, 1ab96d652, d8fa56ed1, d9b5f0112, d332eadab, ef6ea7b5a): seed pushes deleted; scheduler demand-on-stall keystone; body/dispatch/contract/types push-free; semantic.rs converted (~55 threading refs deleted, 8 wait+push pairs -> bare waits, DefineModule(protocol) push proven unreachable, conclude-by-omission bug fixed).

FAMILY 7 — DONE (f7a5ca3d9, three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS 2026-07-03): the last semantic.rs push (analyze_activation callee discovery) replaced by a STANDING ACTIVATION FRONTIER — World::activation_frontier (HashSet<ActivationKey>), maintained SOLELY in World::complete_job (Activation outputs inserted when unsettled, settled ActivationAnalyzed removed), expanded by drive::demand_activation_frontier_analyses at next_ready_job's drain + the stall pass, structurally identical to demand_root_entry_analyses. The has_run guard is LOAD-BEARING: has_run means concluded-or-blocked, so a first-run-but-blocked callee retires from the frontier and re-runs arrive only via changed-revision wakes (without it, a rebased-but-blocked job re-enqueues every stall forever — 50 failures, fact-wait-budget exhaustion; demand_fact_producer's rebased branch bypasses the blocked-skip). Audit-measured: frontier scanned only on agenda drain (~11% of next_ready_job calls, avg ~1.5 entries, peak 7, drains to 0 by drive end); job counts/suite time non-regressed; already_present plumbing deleted repo-wide; jobs/semantic.rs now has ZERO follow_up references. SHARP EDGE for family 8+: any standing-demand expansion over an unbounded key set MUST pre-filter with has_run or equivalent.

THE PUMP'S LAST RESIDUAL (next candidate): resolve_protocol_call's matches.is_empty() branch concludes a callsite with NO wait when ProtocolImplProviders(protocol) doesn't exist yet (the reads.push is has_fact-conditional — first pass drops the re-wake subscription). Fix needs a real wait on ProtocolImplProviders, which first needs settling whether that fact is once-and-done or monotone-growing. Once fixed, TIGHTEN THE PUMP: demand_producer_if_needed skips concluded producers outright, delete the TEMPORARY PUMP comment (drive.rs ~:181).

FAMILY 8+ (inventory verified exact at f7a5ca3d9 by the removable-code audit): jobs/keying.rs 8 (collect_static_graph static call-graph collection); jobs/root.rs 5 (root wait threading); quoted_expander.rs 4 (ModuleInterface wait_on_current pattern); jobs/source.rs 3; source_publish.rs 2 (same ModuleInterface pattern); world.rs 1 = the consumption site (effects.follow_up into scheduler.complete — dies at arc close with the JobEffects field).

TELEMETRY GAP: add an aggregate follow-up-emission counter before declaring the final family complete (pull-based.html's follow_ups=0 proof). demand_on_stall carries demanded_facts metadata.

WATCH ITEMS: (1) coalesced-telemetry conflation (scheduler.rs) — split observability at arc close; (2) Scheduler::blocked/has_run pub-visibility sweep at arc close; (3) product wait loops lack a stall_demanded-style suppression memo (fix when fz-go4.19 dedups the loops); (4) harmless root-entry double-coverage (both demand_root_entry_analyses and the frontier can hold a root entry key; idempotent both ways) — collapse if a natural opportunity appears.

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted; the pump tightened; scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only plus the submit_root ignition; docs updated (fact-engine.md legacy clause dropped; northstar.html tolerance clause updated). Sequencing: fz-go4.18.31 AFTER this ticket's remaining families (both touch the analyze/wake paths).

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.
